'''Coronet Shipping''' was the busiest trade hub on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] which was situated in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] where it prospered as a result of the fact that trade goods from across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] passed through the world regularly on every day. All manner of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] visited its landing pads where they brought goods either legal or otherwise. As a result, Coronet Shipping made millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] per day from commerce occurring through their ports.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Coronet Shipping}}</ref>

All this changed in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded Corellia. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established a beachhead at the [[Blastfield Shipyards]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were quick in securing Coronet Shipping as a rapid response staging area for themselves. The main ground approaches to these landing pads were destroyed by Imperial forces which made the area inaccessible to infantry or [[Walker/Legends|walker]] units. Aerial patrols also kept Republic assault [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] from approaching the site and protected the Empire's elite troops.<ref name="TORC" />
